ambient.about: Backdrops for the wall: things to put glass in front of. They have to hold text, so they stay quiet in the middle and keep their interest at the edges.

prompts.name: dusk-ridge
prompts.prompt: a distant mountain ridge at dusk, deep indigo sky grading to warm amber at the horizon, soft atmospheric haze, minimal, vast negative space, photographic, calm

prompts.name: still-water
prompts.prompt: still water at first light, pale mist, a single dark shoreline low in the frame, muted teal and grey, enormous empty sky, meditative

prompts.name: dune-light
prompts.prompt: sand dunes in late afternoon light, long soft shadows, warm ochre and cream, smooth gradients, abstract and uncluttered

prompts.name: forest-fog
prompts.prompt: conifer forest under heavy fog, receding layers of muted green fading to grey, soft diffuse light, tranquil, plenty of empty space

prompts.name: night-coast
prompts.prompt: a coastline at night under starlight, deep navy and black, faint warm glow at the horizon, very dark, restful, room for bright text

prompts.name: salt-flat
prompts.prompt: a salt flat at golden hour, thin reflective water, pale lilac and gold, near-symmetrical, wide and empty, serene

prompts.name: granite
prompts.prompt: weathered granite rock face, close but abstract, cool grey with faint mineral warmth, soft directional light, texture without busyness

prompts.name: rain-glass
prompts.prompt: rain on a dark window at night, bokeh city light far behind, deep blue-black with amber points, moody and quiet

cave.about: The Barua wall: ochre pigment on stone, the house look.

prompts.name: cave-ochre
prompts.prompt: ancient cave wall, warm ochre and umber pigment on rough stone, faint hand-painted animal forms, soft raking firelight, weathered, earthy, muted

prompts.name: cave-charcoal
prompts.prompt: prehistoric cave painting in charcoal and red earth on pale limestone, sparse marks, deep shadow, quiet and old

prompts.name: cave-dark
prompts.prompt: a dark cave interior, faint warm pigment marks on stone catching low firelight, mostly deep shadow, mysterious, generous darkness

gradient.about: Mesh gradients — genuinely expensive at runtime, free once baked to an image.

prompts.name: mesh-blue
prompts.prompt: smooth abstract mesh gradient, deep blue through violet to soft rose, no banding, glossy, minimal, no shapes or objects

prompts.name: mesh-warm
prompts.prompt: smooth abstract mesh gradient, amber through coral to deep plum, soft blended transitions, minimal, no objects

prompts.name: mesh-cool
prompts.prompt: smooth abstract mesh gradient, teal through emerald to deep navy, soft blended, minimal, no objects
